summary: New toolMiddleware option ((call, next) onion) around the execution of the app's own tools, after every identity, RBAC, approval, budget and revocation check; for logging, metrics, tenant context and error mapping.
howTo: Move a wrapper around tool.execute in loadTools into toolMiddleware: [async (call, next) => ...] on createAiChatHandler (or toolsToAiTools). A throw is a tool error (onToolError, the standard error result), call next at most once, returning without next short-circuits (the result is still bounded), and call.input is a structured copy, so the tool always runs with its validated input; the input must be structured-cloneable. The handler's built-ins (find_tools, read_result, clarification, plan, follow-ups, memory) bypass it. See docs/chat-route-security.md#tool-middleware.
